_note: LLM-generated candidate pool (Claude as LLM) spanning distinct economic mechanisms on the expanded 120-factor Kelly pool. Gated by factor_lab; the first 20 PASS become the valid set.

factors.name: mispr_fin_disc
factors.rationale: Stambaugh-Yuan mispricing reverses more strongly among firms with restrained equity issuance and asset growth (q-theory discipline).

factors.name: mispr_fin_disc_quality
factors.rationale: Mispricing reversal is cleaner when supported by real gross profitability alongside financing and investment discipline.

factors.name: mispr_noa_disc
factors.rationale: Mispricing combined with low net operating assets (Hirshleifer bloat) and low issuance targets over-accruing over-valued firms.

factors.name: cash_prof_accrual_quality
factors.rationale: Ball et al. cash-based profitability with low operating accruals (Sloan) and disciplined issuance = high-quality real earnings.

factors.name: accrual_invest_cashprof
factors.rationale: Total accruals and asset growth are overinvestment/low-quality signals; cash profitability is the real-earnings counterweight.

factors.name: cashprof_lowissue_value
factors.rationale: Cheap, cash-profitable firms that neither issue equity nor grow share count combine value, quality, and financing discipline.

factors.name: ev_value_cashprof
factors.rationale: Enterprise-multiple value (EBIT/book-EV) is cleaner than book-to-market for levered firms; plus cash profitability and low investment.

factors.name: ebitda_value_quality
factors.rationale: EBITDA-to-market-EV value tilted toward quality profitability, penalizing equity issuance.

factors.name: shareholder_yield_quality
factors.rationale: Net payout yield (Boudoukh) plus cash profitability, penalizing issuance: firms returning cash and generating real profits.

factors.name: fcf_yield_discipline
factors.rationale: Free-cash-flow and earnings yield with restrained asset growth identify cheap, cash-generative, disciplined firms.

factors.name: quality_bloat_value
factors.rationale: Asness quality (profitability + safety) tilted to cheap sales-to-price and low balance-sheet bloat (NOA anomaly).

factors.name: qmj_value_lowbeta
factors.rationale: Quality-minus-junk composite plus value, tilted to lower beta (betting-against-beta).

factors.name: issuance_mom_reversal
factors.rationale: Low equity and debt financing plus intermediate momentum, guarded against short-term reversal = capital discipline + underreaction.

factors.name: netissuance_quality_mom
factors.rationale: Net total issuance discipline with profitability and momentum, controlling short-term reversal.

factors.name: pead_earnings_revenue
factors.rationale: Post-earnings-announcement drift: earnings and revenue surprises predict drift; revenue surprise confirms; guard reversal.

factors.name: earnings_streak_mom
factors.rationale: Consecutive earnings-increase streaks (earnings momentum) plus price momentum, guarded against reversal.

factors.name: profit_minus_lottery
factors.rationale: Bali MAX/lottery and Ang idiosyncratic-vol anomalies: long cash-profitable, non-lottery, low-idio-vol names.

factors.name: value_prof_lowrisk
factors.rationale: Cheap, profitable firms with low idiosyncratic risk and disciplined issuance — a four-category composite.

factors.name: distress_adjusted_value
factors.rationale: Value works better among financially healthy firms (Piotroski / Campbell distress): cheap + high Altman-Z + low idio risk.

factors.name: safe_value_prof
factors.rationale: Value and profitability are more robust among safer, lower-beta firms than distressed cheap stocks.

factors.name: cashprof_trend_value
factors.rationale: Improving cash-profitability trend plus cheap valuation and low issuance captures underreacted quality recovery.

factors.name: persistent_mispricing_disc
factors.rationale: Persistent (not transient) mispricing plus persistently low issuance identifies durable anomaly exposure.

factors.name: earnings_yield_stability
factors.rationale: Earnings yield scaled by earnings volatility rewards stable high-yield earners (quality of E/P), plus cash profitability.

factors.name: riskadj_momentum_disc
factors.rationale: Risk-adjusted momentum (information-ratio style) combined with financing discipline.

factors.name: opprof_value_lowissue
factors.rationale: Operating profitability with assets-to-market value, disciplined issuance, and reversal control.

factors.name: niq_roa_value_disc
factors.rationale: Quarterly ROA with value and investment/financing discipline captures profitable cheap disciplined firms.

factors.name: gpmargin_value_quality
factors.rationale: Operating margin plus value and quality, penalizing asset growth.

factors.name: mispr_profit_lowrisk
factors.rationale: Mispricing supported by profitability and concentrated in low-idio-vol, more investable names.

factors.name: mispr_liquidity_guard
factors.rationale: Mispricing tilted toward more liquid, lower-spread, lower-price-impact stocks for implementability.

factors.name: value_mom_lowvol
factors.rationale: Value and momentum are more persistent when total and idiosyncratic volatility are low.

factors.name: debt_discipline_value
factors.rationale: Low debt issuance and leverage with value and cash profitability captures conservatively financed cheap firms.

factors.name: coa_growth_quality
factors.rationale: Change in current operating assets and asset growth are overinvestment signals; cash profitability offsets them.

factors.name: invest_efficiency_value
factors.rationale: Cash profitability per unit of asset growth (efficient profit generation) with value and issuance discipline.

factors.name: quality_growth_value
factors.rationale: Profitability quality and ROE tilted to cheap sales-to-price and low bloat.

factors.name: mispr_mgmt_accrual
factors.rationale: The management mispricing cluster (net issuance, accruals, investment) reinforced by low accruals, low issuance, profitability.

factors.name: value_profit_issue_growth
factors.rationale: The canonical four-way composite: value, profitability, low issuance, low investment.

factors.name: sale_value_prof_disc
factors.rationale: Sales-to-price with operating profitability, disciplined share issuance and asset growth.

factors.name: mispr_value_lowbeta
factors.rationale: Mispricing plus value concentrated in lower-beta names (low-risk anomaly interaction).

factors.name: prof_trend_issue_disc
factors.rationale: Improving profitability trend and level with financing and investment discipline captures underreacted quality.

factors.name: netpayout_value_lowrisk
factors.rationale: Net payout yield with value, concentrated in low-idiosyncratic-risk names for cleaner exposure.
